title: Age-dependent leukocyte interpretation: an exploratory cross-survey test of incremental CRP prediction
abstract: Adding a centered age × log(WBC) interaction changed transported weighted Brier loss from 0.175636 to 0.176065 (delta +0.000429; approximate joint PSU bootstrap95% [-0.000015,+0.000905]); improvement was not established under the registered criterion. Source NHANES III; target separately recruited NHANES2017–2018. An exploratory representation test on previously explored surveys, not untouched confirmation or a new biomarker.
